issues.on_page: Other Local Receipts, General Fund column 39,377 = 1911 Other Local Licenses 6,697 + 1920 Other Contributions 13,040 (p6) + Depreciation Fund 'Fund Transfer In' 12,000 (p10) + Employee Benefit 'Transfer from General Fund' 7,640 (p11)
issues.issue: A transfer is hidden inside a receipt line. The p4 General column combines the General, Depreciation and Employee Benefit funds and books 19,640 of interfund transfers as Other Local Receipts. That 19,640 is recorded here as revenue. It should be split out as an other financing transfer in (split_from + review), not kept as receipts. The extractor saw this (notes) but kept it as revenue.

issues.on_page: Contra line -19,640 (transfer payments to Depreciation 12,000 and Employee Benefit 7,640) plus a matching transfers_out. The General fund schedule p9 '8000 Transfers (Outgoing) 112,008' covers only Activities 40,908 (p12) + Nutrition 71,100 (p13), and General fund cash rolls forward without the 19,640 (1,777,786 + 5,264,476 - 5,261,816 = 1,780,446), so the payment sits inside General fund spending lines.
issues.issue: A transfer is hidden inside spending lines. Governmental disbursements (p5 General column 5,153,882 = General 5,149,808 + Employee Benefit 4,074) include 19,640 that is really a transfer, so the same money counts as both spending and a transfer. The page doesn't show which line holds it, so the rule calls for keeping the printed lines and adding a negative contra expenditure line (department = General fund spending, split_from, review) plus the other financing line. Neither was added.

issues.extracted: Depreciation 'Fund Transfer In' +12,000 (detail[83]) and Employee Benefit 'Transfer from General Fund' +7,640 (detail[84]) recorded as other financing; General fund detail has only -112,008
issues.on_page: p9 Transfers (Outgoing) 112,008 = 40,908 + 71,100; the 19,640 paid to Depreciation/Employee Benefit sits in General fund expenditure lines
issues.issue: Detail transfers don't net: +12,000 + 7,640 + 40,908 + 71,100 - 112,008 = +19,640. The General fund schedule's expenditure lines still contain the 19,640 that the receiving funds record as transfers, so that money appears as both spending and a transfer. A General fund contra expenditure line (-19,640, split_from, review) and an other financing line of -19,640 are missing.

issues.on_page: General fund parts printed on p6: 1911 Other Local Licenses 6,697; 1920 Other Contributions 13,040
issues.issue: Apart from the 19,640 transfer, the line is licenses (6,697) and contributions (13,040), so 'other' is not needed. Contributions is the dominant category.

issues.extracted: County Fines and Fees (General Fund column) / Other Local Receipts (… column)
issues.on_page: County Fines and Fees 78,251; Other Local Receipts 272,306
issues.issue: The combined lines were split by fund column (receipts[10], [11], [15]-[20]). The column amounts are printed and the sums are right (12,251+66,000 = 78,251; 39,377+203,682+5,390+14,400+8,986+471 = 272,306), but the original_label values add column names that aren't printed as labels.

issues.on_page: School Nutrition Fund shown as a column of the governmental funds statements (p4-5); no proprietary statement
issues.issue: School nutrition is normally business-type under the rules. Here the report presents it as a governmental fund and gives no proprietary statement, so keeping it governmental is defensible but an assumption.

issues.on_page: Budget 10,000 printed only on the Total Cash Receipts / Total Cash Disbursements lines
issues.issue: The Student Fee lines (detail[123], [124]) take budget_final from the total line, while every other fund schedule leaves budget_final null where the budget is printed only on totals. This is inconsistent.
